# Pitney Bowes Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 15, 2026 8am EDT


SHELTON, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Pitney Bowes Inc. (NYSE: PBI), a technology-driven products and services company that provides digital shipping solutions, mailing innovation, and financial services to clients around the world – including more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500 – today announced that it will report third quarter 2026 earnings results after market close on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.


The Company will host an investor conference call the next day on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET to review its results. This call and all supplemental information can be accessed on Pitney Bowes’ investor relations site at[https://www.investorrelations.pitneybowes.com/](https://www.investorrelations.pitneybowes.com/) .


**Pitney Bowes Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results** When: Thursday, October 29, 2026
Time: 8:00 a.m. ET
Webcast:[Webcast Link](https://app.webinar.net/QXO6Wr98zwA)


A recording of the call will also be available on the Company’s website after the call.


**About Pitney Bowes**


Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI) is a technology-driven products and services company that provides digital shipping solutions, mailing innovation, and financial services to clients around the world – including more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500. Small businesses to large enterprises, and government entities rely on Pitney Bowes to reduce the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For the latest news, corporate announcements, and financial results, visit[www.pitneybowes.com/us/newsroom](http://www.pitneybowes.com/us/newsroom) . For additional information, visit Pitney Bowes at[www.pitneybowes.com](http://www.pitneybowes.com/) .
